events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi. This is Maria Alvarez. Born 03/14/1968. I need a refill of my inhaler.
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I found albuterol inhaler and budesonide inhaler on your record. Which one do you want the prescribing team to review for a refill request?
Let me find that on your record.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, albuterol inhaler, two puffs every four to six hours when needed, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Your request reference is R Q, six three four eight. It is awaiting prescribing team review, and they will call or text you with the outcome.
